title: Control Execution Graph
description: SECB-WP-FWK-082, issue #147. Replaces filename-pattern discovery of controls with the paths CI actually invokes. STATIC_EXECUTION_GRAPH <-> RUNTIME_EXECUTION_RECEIPT <-> CONTROL_SURFACE_REGISTRY are three separate views: this schema describes the FIRST, and a static graph cannot observe the second. Each control path carries six independent statuses and none of them implies the next.

level.description: Enforcement scripts import the standard library only (NFR-12), so no YAML library is available. The parser recognises a declared subset of workflow syntax; anything outside it becomes an UNRESOLVED_DYNAMIC_EDGE rather than silence.

recognised.description: jobs, steps, run, uses, if, needs, strategy.matrix, continue-on-error

why.description: Unrecognised keys and YAML anchors/aliases are reported as edges AND force REACHABILITY_NOT_PROVEN, so the subset's blind spots degrade the claim rather than passing silently.

axes.description: CONTROL_SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP != CI_REACHABILITY != RESULT_CONSUMPTION != CI_ENFORCEMENT. Four independent axes: being in the registry says nothing about running, running says nothing about anyone reading the result, and none of it says a merge is blocked.

CI_REACHABILITY.description: UNCONDITIONAL is deliberately absent. A step with no `if` still carries GitHub's default success() condition, so a previous step's failure skips it; the absence of an explicit condition is an observation about the file, not a guarantee about execution. REACHABILITY_NOT_PROVEN is returned whenever the parser met syntax it does not model.

DIRECT_JOB_FAILURE_PROPAGATION.description: false is proven under continue-on-error: the step cannot fail its job DIRECTLY.

DOWNSTREAM_RESULT_CONSUMPTION.description: continue-on-error does not stop a later step reading steps.<id>.outcome, so nobody-read-it is a separate and unobserved claim.

unresolved_edges.description: Edges the parser could not follow. An unresolved edge is reported, never dropped: a silent omission is indistinguishable from an absent control.

workflows_parsed.description: Workflow files the parser actually read. Emitted since the graph was first produced; the schema omitted it while declaring additionalProperties:false, so every document this tool has ever emitted violated its own declared contract.
